newsitem.title: USA: Information Resource has Argentina contract.
newsitem.headline: Information Resource has Argentina contract.

text.p: Information Resource Engineering Inc said Wednesday it was awarded a contract to protect Internet based communications between Interbanking SA and its 3,000 corporate customers in Argentina.
The company declined to disclose the value of the contract.
The company said the contract stipulates that it will provide its SafeNet products to each Interbanking SA customer over the next twelve months.
Interbanking SA's corporate customers manage financial transactions electronically over computer networks. Interbanking outsources all network management to the Electronic Data Systems Corp.
IRE's SafeNet Internet security products use encryption technology to protect data.
